INNOVATION.. PRECISION..  RELIABILITY

Top Art® is a brand of solid surface material composed primarily of acrylic polymer and alumina trihydrate (ATH), which is derived from bauxite ore. Characterized by its non-porous nature, Top Art® is stain-resistant, seamless, repairable, thermoformable, and heat-resistant. It comes in a wide array of colors and patterns, making it a versatile choice for various applications in both residential and commercial environments.

Facebook X-twitter Youtube Linkedin

Topart®

Top Art® is commonly used for:

  • Countertops: Popular in kitchens and bathrooms due to its ease of cleaning and variety of designs.
  • Sinks and Backsplashes: Its seamless nature allows for unique installations.
  • Public Spaces: Used in healthcare and commercial environments, where hygienic surfaces are paramount.
  • Furniture: Its adaptability in terms of shapes and finishes makes it suitable for various furniture designs.

Overall, Top Art® is recognized for its ability to blend aesthetic appeal with practical functionality, making it a popular choice among architects and designers.

Topart® Solid Surface

Topart® is an advanced composite product used as an architectural and design material in a variety of residential and commercial applications. Topart® solid surface offers design versatility, functionality and durability. Supplied in sheets and shapes, it can be fabricated into virtually any design. It is the original solid surface material made only by Acrylic Material.

What we offer you?

With innovative designs and an enduring color palette, Topart® will make all of your design aspirations come true. Achieve your dreams while still selecting a quality product that will stand up to whatever your life may throw at it. You can rest easy knowing you’ve picked a surface to last a lifetime!
REPAIRABLE

Topart® surfaces are renewable and inherently environmentally friendly. Heavy stains and scratches can be erased without a trace simply by rubbing with household cleaner. Just a little effort will soon return the surface of Topart® to mint condition.

DURABLE

Topart® keeps its good looks and survives the impact nicks and cuts that can occur with daily wear and tear.

TOUGH

Since its introduction, Topart® sheet has proven itself to be remarkably durable, a versatile material that is easy to live with in both domestic and commercial environments. Topart® cannot delaminate, the joints are inconspicuous and fluids cannot penetrate.

SEAMLESS

Color-coordinated Joint Adhesive bonds Topart® solid surface with inconspicuous seams. This results in a smooth surface that enables you to create large designs fashioned from a single element. The seamless look of integrated Topart® countertops, sinks, and coved backsplashes also means there are no crevices to trap dirt and bacteria.

EASY TO CLEAN

Topart® sheet has a non-porous surface that prevents dirt and stains from penetrating the material. Marks and stains stay on the surface and can easily be removed with a Scotch-brite pad and household cleaner.

NON-POROUS

Topart® sheet is nonporous and hygienic. Its smooth surface does not allow liquids to penetrate and that makes it easy to clean. Bacteria and mold have nowhere to take root. When Topart® sheet looks clean, it really is clean.
